subjectTemplate: An IFPA administrator has corrected something on your footbag.org record
bodyTemplate:
Hi {memberName},

An IFPA administrator has corrected {whatChanged} on your account. Nothing else about your membership has changed.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can see your record by logging in to footbag.org and opening your profile. If you believe this was corrected in error, submit a contact request from your profile edit page.
